items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 170:1
items.html: Just as the place of BYA in its entirety is divided into the three worlds BYA, which are the place of holiness, and into the fourteen Sefirot, which are a permanent dwelling place for the Klipot, so this world is divided into the place of settlement, which includes BYA, the place of the Temple, the Land of Israel, and outside the Land, and into the place of ruins, which are the deserts, where there is no settlement of people, a land that no man has passed through. (Item 44).
